Notes: Gallery leading into a mountain. The inner part of the mining tunnel includes a rectangular room. This part is broken down and filled with soil (visible in green color). The blue color indicates the part of the gallery which is still empty and accessible (void). It is located in a depth of approx. 4 m (13,1 ft).

Next to the gallery is another tunnel system indicated by green color.

The orange color indicates the mineralized ground.
